messages:
Chris (CEO): leaving a quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. thanks for the thoughtful questions on apac prewarm and autoscale. drop any lingering asks here and infra will respond.
Maya (Infra PM): short update: APAC phased prewarm starts next quarter. phase 1 = cache-only warm pools + regional buffer. phase 2 = optional reserved slots for enterprise. more details below.
Tess (Product): product question: will cache-only mode reduce cold-starts enough for chat flows? any SLA changes?
Maya (Infra PM): cache-only will warm KV and embeddings, so most short chat requests see <200ms extra lat versus reserved. we will not guarantee hard capacity in cache-only under sustained surge. SLA unchanged; only reserved gives capacity guarantees.
Arjun (Capacity): procurement note: added 120 T4-equivalent slots to APAC for phase 2, ETA late-May. still limited for large sequence models. pricing for reserved slots coming.
Sam (SRE): ops concern: cross-region fallback increases latency and egress. can we have a per-route flag to disallow cross-region failover for latency-sensitive routes?
Maya (Infra PM): yes, adding routing flag `allow_cross_region_fallback: true|false`. default true. console will expose it under route failover settings.
Tess (Product): product wants recommended defaults for small teams who won't touch config. can we ship sane defaults?
Sam (SRE): recommended defaults: allow_cross_region_fallback=true, prewarm_mode=cache_only, surge_window=30s, sustained_window=10m. will publish rationale.
Arjun (Capacity): cost note: cross-region fallback to eu may be 2-3x compute cost and ~15-30% network egress added. we'll publish per-model multipliers.
notify-bot: runbook draft published -> https://console.internal/runbooks/apac-prewarm-v1 (auto message)
Maya (Infra PM): linking runbook. it includes fallback ordering, config snippets, and canary playbook. please review.
Chris (CEO): thanks. final ask: can we add a short customer-facing FAQ explaining the three prewarm modes and expected latency delta? Tess, pair with Arjun + Sam.
Tess (Product): will do, aiming for draft Thursday.
Sam (SRE): also adding synthetic tests for canary: chat_short, chat_long_context, embedding_warmup. will link when ready.
Arjun (Capacity): will upload cost samples per model to the pricing doc after runbook review.
Maya (Infra PM): closing loop here. i'll post a summary + checklist for teams when the console toggle goes live.
Chris (CEO): awesome. drop final questions here and we'll triage. :rocket:
